releaseNotes: v0.1.5 (beta): New Tips & Troubleshooting page in the app, starting with exactly what runs locally and what still needs the Roborock cloud. v0.1.4 (beta): Diagnostics button on the vacuum device logs model, firmware, protocol and the raw status in one block for testers to send. Full logging stays on for 3 hours during the beta. v0.1.3 (beta): Quieter reconnects. The vacuum closes its local connection now and then; the driver now reconnects within a few seconds and only shows offline if it stays down for 90 s. A command sent while reconnecting is sent once connected. v0.1.0 (beta): First build. Local control of Roborock vacuums over the vacuum's own TCP port, no cloud after a one-time sign-in. Supports the newer L01 protocol (Qrevo Curv and similar) and the older 1.0 protocol. Attribute and command names match bloodtick's Roborock driver so existing rules carry over.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Roborock Integration
apps.description: Signs in to Roborock once to bring in your vacuums, their local keys and room names, and creates a device for each.

drivers.name: Roborock Vacuum
drivers.description: One vacuum, controlled locally: status, start, dock, pause, room cleaning, fan and mop modes, consumables.
